blocks.text: Functions can take several parameters and return a value with return. A function can be called many times with different arguments, reusing the same code (Did You Know).

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)

blocks.prompt: Class activity: define a function that takes a list of numbers and returns the maximum.
blocks.explanation: def biggest(nums): big = nums[0]; for n in nums: if n > big: big = n; return big. Python's built-in max(nums) does the same.

items: Parameters receive inputs; return sends a result back: add(2, 3) gives 5.
